requiredPermissions: Account: Access Apps and Policies: Edit

operatorRules: Keep the gateway origin bound to 127.0.0.1.
Expose only the operator-agent gateway port through the tunnel.
Protect the public hostname with Cloudflare Access; do not add a bypass rule.
Store gateway and tunnel tokens in Infisical only.
Expose no write modes through the HTTP gateway until the MCP/identity policy path is reviewed.
Stop the local tunnel replica when public access is no longer needed.
